scope: All 33 active scientific repositories placed in one theory-reality ecological research system. Series remain distinct ownership units.
system_surface: REALITY <-> OBSERVATION <-> DISTINCTIONS <-> IDENTIFICATION <-> DESIGN <-> REALITY
system_rule: connection != ownership; developmental ancestry != conceptual hierarchy; empirical projection != validation

node_roles.hotarubukuro: focal Campanula flower-colour geography publication system
node_roles.chun: evolutionary-time and molecular flower-colour recurrence programme
node_roles.azami: present-day thistle image-phenomics and environmental structure
node_roles.EAzami: public-data evolutionary history and recurrence/depth discrimination
node_roles.aza3: own-data ancestry × phenotype × cytotype history discrimination
node_roles.izu-core: conditional island interaction-response geometry and empirical interface
node_roles.shimahotarubukuro: focal Izu Campanula floral phenotype divergence
node_roles.pollipi: physical flower-visitor primary-record system; application/testbed rather than parent theory
node_roles.insepi: physical observer-system intervention diagnosis focused on nuisance/observability/shared-optical failure
node_roles.rec: missing-support / record-entry censoring: what existed but failed to become a usable row
node_roles.v3: retained-side-information refinement: contract compatible world sets without destructive subtraction
node_roles.tnoa: semantic preservation on retained support: keep target/nuisance/observability/attribution/unresolved distinctions
node_roles.boundary: identification boundary induced by the current observation map
node_roles.mrod: active next-observation design for remaining compatible mechanism/world distinctions
node_roles.theouni: meta-theory, admission grammar and portfolio registry
node_roles.sch: shared-coordinate functional conflict and compromise geometry
node_roles.bita: differentiated-coordinate architecture gain and mechanism-allocation boundary
node_roles.sdmr: environmental-coordinate admission and leakage-free SDM method
node_roles.odsp: multidimensional niche geometry and state-resolved prediction
node_roles.acsp: bounded candidate-patch survey prioritization and field-return interface

observation_theory.rule: REC/V3/TNOA are sibling information operations. They feed the current observation map; Boundary audits surviving equivalence and MROD chooses a future distinction. PolliPi/InsePi instantiate the problem physically for flower-visitation observation.

within_series_state_transitions.surface: shared-coordinate compromise -> middle world -> differentiated architecture
present phenotype -> public history -> own-data discrimination

theory_reality_contacts.object: what biological evidence is needed -> where to search
candidate geography -> field verification / primary-data intake
specific mechanism ambiguity -> general identification boundary

cross_series_relations.object: Honshu-Izu functional interaction data under different questions
WHAT to measure <-> WHERE to look

system_cycle: encounter a distinction or failure in a real biological/measurement system
abstract a state, observation, interaction or world object
derive a boundary, theorem or design rule
project the object back into a measurable natural or physical system
retain negative, non-identifiable, failed-transport and residual outcomes as scientific information
use them to revise the representation or choose the next observation
return to field or natural data without erasing provenance
non_edges: shared philosophy or TMOP membership alone is not a scientific edge
PolliPi/InsePi development ancestry does not make them conceptually upstream of TNOA/V3/REC
EGWEE does not externally validate the EGC/EGWE finite-model mechanism
shared organism or dataset does not transfer conclusions
later empirical work does not retroactively validate an earlier bounded/failed gate
